intent: Convert a consequential system question into an evidenced architecture decision and implementation-ready handoff.
successCondition: The selected design traces to requirements and repository reality, compares viable alternatives, defines interfaces and failure behavior, and terminates with testable acceptance conditions.

direct: make and record a durable architecture decision
reconcile an existing architecture with new requirements
paraphrased: choose the system boundaries and interfaces before implementation
turn these constraints into an implementation-ready technical design
work through competing designs and commit to one evidenced decision
contextual: a durable system decision is blocking downstream implementation
an approved product direction still lacks interfaces and failure contracts
existing code and new requirements disagree about the architecture

negativeIntents: implementation of an already approved plan
open-ended ideation without a system decision
